product.title: Full-Day Singapore Tour: 8-Hour Private Experience with a Local

description.text: In Singapore, this private eight-hour walking day is shaped by a local host instead of a fixed coach script. Published options include Marina Bay Sands Skypark, Gardens by the Bay, Chinatown, and Tiong Bahru, with the host suggesting MRT or taxi links when the group wants to cover more ground. The default meeting is Starbucks at Chinatown Point on New Bridge Road; a central hotel meetup can be confirmed in advance. Food, attraction tickets, and transport fares are listed separately. The format suits visitors who want a full Singapore day without booking four district tours independently. Meeting points are confirmed at booking in Singapore, and the itinerary stays on Marina Bay Sands Skypark, Gardens by the Bay, Chinatown, and Tiong Bahru that shape this outing rather than a Pulau Ubin add-on.
